image_description: A close-up, high-resolution portrait of a wood rabbit (cottontail) situated in natural grassy vegetation. The rabbit is facing slightly right, with its head and upper torso clearly visible. It has brownish-grey fur, large dark eyes, and upright ears. A blade of grass obscures the lower part of the mouth/nose area.
